messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to lock the rollout strategy for the Priority Toggle v3 feature. Acme and BetaCorp pressed for earlier access; scope negotiation is still open. High-level proposal: staged regional canaries + customer opt-ins + an experiment A/B ramp. Questions: canary sizing, telemetry gates, and a clear fallback chain.

Jonathan: +1. For canary size I was thinking 1% global -> 5% -> 20% over 48h windows, but region-first might make more sense (EU -> NA -> APAC). What metrics are our signal gates?

Ashley: We should gate on three signals: 1) error-rate (5xx & inference error increase), 2) tail latency (p95/p99 increase > 20%), 3) output quality regression on eval prompts (automated eval failing more than 3%). Also add cost-per-token alert for Dedicated customers.

Saleh: From infra POV: reserve burst capacity in NA and EU for the 20% step. If we do region-first, we should do EU small cohort then NA. APAC needs separate cooldown since we have fewer nodes there. Also propose a 30-min warmup smoke job after each step.

Maya: Good. For customer opt-ins: propose a config toggle per-tenant with opt-in list and per-tenant kill switch. That keeps Acme/BetaCorp happy without global risk.

Jonathan: Agree re per-tenant opt-in. For the A/B side, do we want a holdback group for telemetry baselining? I'd keep 10% holdback within each region for comparison.

Ashley: 10% holdback is fine. That gives us relative metrics. Also: define the rollback ladder — auto rollback on any gate breach plus manual immediate kill if sample-quality fails badly.

Maya: Draft rollback ladder idea: 
1) soft degrade (route to model variant / cheaper quantized model) if latency or infra errors spike
2) pause ramp (stop at current cohort until signals stabilize)
3) per-tenant opt-out (auto-exempt customers on SLA)
4) full kill and hotfix if quality regression > threshold for 2 consecutive windows

Saleh: Technically feasible. Need the following runbooks: quick switch to variant, pause-at-flag controller, and full kill endpoint with audit logging. I can owner-run the variant-switch runbook.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy job started for feature-toggle/v3 -> eu-small-cohort (job id: 67821). Logs: BUILD OK, RUNTIME TESTS OK, smoke-run queued.

Jonathan: Example of the feature flag config I'd expect (pseudo):
```json
{
  "flag": "priority_toggle_v3",
  "stages": [
    {"region": "eu", "cohort_pct": 1, "holdback_pct": 10},
    {"region": "na", "cohort_pct": 5, "holdback_pct": 10},
    {"region": "apac", "cohort_pct": 5, "holdback_pct": 10}
  ],
  "auto_rollbacks": {"error_rate": 2.0, "p99_latency_pct": 20, "quality_regression_pct": 3},
  "per_tenant_opt_in": true
}
```

Ashley: Love that. Add a telemetry tag so every request in the cohort is annotated: feature=priority_toggle_v3, cohort_id, region. That makes slicing in Console straightforward.

Maya: Launch criteria checklist draft: 
- infra smoke tests green after warmup (owner: Saleh)
- telemetry coverage for cohort flags enabled (owner: Jonathan)
- eval harness shows no >3% regression (owner: Ashley)
- customer opt-in config tested with 2 tenants (owner: Maya)
- runbook + rollback tested (owner: Saleh)

Jonathan: Timing: propose start cohort in EU tomorrow 09:00 UTC, wait 24h then evaluate. If green, NA 24h after, then APAC after another 48h. Each step: wait for two evaluation windows (12h each) before moving.

Ashley: Can we include an A/B quality check job that runs a blind eval set every 6h and posts diff to #product-alerts? If regression appears, auto-tag the runbook and notify oncall.

Maya: Yes — add that to the checklist. Also negotiate scope: BetaCorp wants an extra logging field in responses. That adds ~1 day of work; consider shipping without it to start and toggle it on later for them specifically. Thoughts?

Saleh: Shipping without the extra log field reduces risk. We can gate the logging field behind tenant flag for BetaCorp and roll it in parallel as a separate small canary.

Jonathan: Decision log: Start without extra log field in v3. Add as v3.1 tenant-gated rollout after initial stability.

Maya: Action items: 
- Saleh: prepare runbooks + reserve capacity (ETA: today EOD)
- Jonathan: enable telemetry tags + set up eval job in Console (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Ashley: finalize eval pass and alert thresholds (ETA: tomorrow morning)
- Maya: confirm customer opt-in list and tenant flags with Acme/BetaCorp (ETA: today)

Ashley: I'll also prepare the pager rule for the quality-eval alert and include the 2-stage escalation (oncall -> eng-product lead).

Saleh: I'll post a short test checklist here before EU kickoff. ops-bot: please run smoke job at 08:30 UTC pre-warm.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled smoke job for 2024-05-15T08:30:00Z queued (job id: 67822).

Maya: Thanks — looks like we have a path. If no objections by EOD I'll publish the rollout plan doc and kick the canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Jonathan: :+1:

Ashley: :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Plan locked for Priority Toggle v3: staged regional canaries, per-tenant opt-ins, 10% holdback, telemetry gates (error rate, p99 latency, quality regression), rollback ladder and runbooks. Action items assigned for runbooks, telemetry, evals, and customer opt-ins. Decision: postpone extra logging field to v3.1 tenant-gated rollout.
